decisions.reason: Premium support sits close to the core agency-focused service promise, and a hiring, growing firm has the slack to carry it, so there is no shortfall to trigger search for other uses.
The version manager builds on the established management tools, had its own page and was highlighted as a current feature, which points to results meeting aspirations.
The contract tool is distant from the core hosting business and its value may fade once GDPR demand settles, but it costs little to maintain and the firm has slack, so it is likely kept for now.
Scalable agency hosting is the flagship that matches the firm's strategic direction and industry growth, so management will keep and develop it.
